# illumio-core_deny_rule (Data Source)

Represents Illumio Deny Rule

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "illumio-core_deny_rule" "example" {
  href = "/orgs/1/sec_policy/draft/rule_sets/1/deny_rules/1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `href` (String) URI of the Deny Rule

### Read-Only

- `all_ips_except_for_in_consumers` (Boolean) Whether the consumer side is everything except what the consumers resolve to
- `all_ips_except_for_in_providers` (Boolean) Whether the provider side is everything except what the providers resolve to
- `consumers` (Set of Object) Consumers of the Deny Rule - the sources that initiate the connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumers))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when this Deny Rule was first created
- `created_by` (Map of String) User who created this Deny Rule
- `deleted_at` (String) Timestamp when this Deny Rule was deleted
- `deleted_by` (Map of String) User who deleted this Deny Rule
- `description` (String) Description of the Deny Rule
- `egress_services` (Set of Object) Collection of egress services (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress_services))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Determines whether the deny rule is enabled in the rule set
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ingress_services` (Set of Object) Collection of ingress services (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ingress_services))
- `network_type` (String) Network types this rule applies to
- `override` (Boolean) Whether this is an override-deny rule that takes precedence over allow rules. The policy evaluation order is override-deny > allow > deny
- `providers` (Set of Object) Providers of the Deny Rule - the destinations that provide the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))
- `rule_set_href` (String) URI of the rule set containing this Deny Rule
- `unscoped_consumers` (Boolean) Whether the scope for rule consumers is set to All
- `update_type` (String) Type of the update
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when this Deny Rule was last updated
- `updated_by` (Map of String) User who last updated this Deny Rule
